_why_two_claims: AGREEMENT asks whether the engines compute the same thing; RECOVERY asks whether they compute the right thing. Neither implies the other.

truth.source: the fixture's data-generating process: the marginal risk difference, integrated by fixture.truth() and checked with scipy quad

agreement.claim: both engines report the same weighted risk difference, stacked and weights-fixed SEs, and complete-case comparator
agreement._note: Observed spread on the committed fixture: 0. harness/missing_examples.test.py rebuilds the stacked sandwich with numerical derivatives (1e-7) and shows complete-case analysis biased by more than 0.03 on average.

recovery.claim: the estimate is close to the fixture's

calibration.rule: about 1.3 times the measured 99th percentile miss, rounded up
calibration.limits: The tolerance just separates the effect (-0.102) from zero. A first fixture's dropout pattern left complete-case analysis biased by only 0.005 in expectation; the fixture now has a stronger prognostic factor and more dropout on control. Measured by harness/missing_examples.test.py over seeds 0 to 99 (MALLARD_SEEDS=100); CI reruns it on seeds 0 to 49.
